module: Demo scenario extension: gives the vehicle a boost by applying a constant wind directed along its forward axis via obj:setWind. Can be triggered on each upshift (listenToShift) or manually (manualBoost). The boost lasts `boostTime` seconds, counted down in updateGFX.
usage:
scenario_shiftBooster.manualBoost(1.0, 500) -- boost 1 s, force 500
scenario_shiftBooster.listenToShift()  -- boost 0.4 s on each shiftUp
notes: listenToShift replaces drivetrain.shiftUp; but drivetrain.lua (loaded as the global `drivetrain` by main.lua) contains no shiftUp function in 0.40.5. up_for_real is therefore nil and the replacement will crash on the first call: obsolete code (inconsistency spotted).
The default force is 300 (obj:setWind wind unit, inferred from code); the direction vector is multiplied by the force.
When boostTime drops below 0.01, updateGFX resets the wind to (0,0,0) every frame, which overwrites any other wind set by the vehicle.
applyBoost prints on every call (noisy in the logs).

listenToShift.desc: Wraps drivetrain.shiftUp: after the actual gear change, sets boostTime to 0.4 s, shows a UI message "Boooooost!" (5 s) and applies a boost with the default force.

manualBoost.desc: Starts a manual boost: sets boostTime to the given duration and applies the boost immediately.

strength.desc: Intensity multiplied by the direction vector; 300 if nil.

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame by the main loop (extensions.hook('updateGFX')). While boostTime > 0.01: decrements it by dt and reapplies the boost; otherwise resets the wind to zero.

onDebugDraw.desc: Debug draw hook: if a boost is active, draws a sphere of radius boostTime 2 m above the vehicle, with a varying color.

onVehicleScenarioData.desc: Scenario configuration hook; empty body, no data is read.
